results.title: Seahawks' Dark Side D silences Patriots in Super Bowl: Takeaways
highlights:
# Seahawks slow Patriots, take home Super Bowl 60 win: Score, highlights
...
The Seattle Seahawks are NFL champions for the 2025 season after taking down the New England Patriots, 29-13, in a defensive showdown. Neither team’s offense scored a touchdown until two were scored on consecutive possessions to open the fourth quarter – and then only once more.
...
Ultimately, Seattle won because its “Dark Side” defense – the 2025 Seahawks’ answer to the franchise’s “Legion of Boom” defense of the decade prior – was more overwhelming than New England’s. The Seahawks sacked Patriots quarterback Drake Maye six times for 43 cumulative yards lost. They forced three turnovers that led to two touchdowns and a field goal, and the Seattle defense didn’t allow New England into the red zone until the final three minutes of the game.
